summary: String lifetime and comparison handling, nested aggregate reuse, clearer diagnostics, and a recorded stdlib identity make this toolchain more predictable and easier to audit.

highlights.title: Str lifetimes, comparators, and tuple patterns
highlights.text: Returned Str values keep their ownership across match arms, so a fresh string is not freed while it is still in use. Str comparators behind function-typed parameters compare contents even when passed by value, and tuple patterns over Option and Result bind every nested element.

highlights.title: Nested aggregates and aggregate returns reclaim memory
highlights.text: Copying, modifying, and writing back a nested aggregate field no longer emits an invalid vector extractvalue, so a module-level Vec of struct values compiles. Aggregate returns through Option and Result free their owned payload containers, and large allocations request transparent huge pages on Linux.

highlights.title: Clearer diagnostics and a recorded stdlib identity
highlights.text: Windows build and check failures now report a diagnostic instead of exiting silently. Every release archive carries a stdlib commit file with the exact bundled commit, and the release publishes a top-level stdlib identity asset that is checksummed with the other downloads.

highlights.title: HTTP/1.1 and WebSocket framing hardening
highlights.text: Strict Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding checks, CTL/NUL rejection, RSV/opcode/control-frame checks, valid close codes/reasons and UTF-8 text, and no negative consumed frame lengths. The request-smuggling shapes and the remote WebSocket crash are closed.

highlights.title: THP large allocations and owned Int formatting
highlights.text: Large xiom_alloc blocks hint 2 MiB transparent huge pages before zeroing on Linux x86_64. convert.to_string uses the owned + concat so the slice temporary is freed instead of retained.

highlights.title: Contract tail retired
highlights.text: The public API has 0 EX-0 exemptions: 276 uncovered functions carry per-function EX-1..EX-5 records, coverage is 6,716/6,992 (96.1%), and the ownership map and sign-off policy are in docs.

known_issues: The libc user-symbol mangling change is deferred to a later release.
Selfhost phase 8 remains incomplete; no bootstrap binary ships in this release.
Tier-3 lint stays opt-in; making it default-on is a separate decision.
